node.statement: For every q>=1 and T in M_q(B(H)), the amplification Phi_q is UCP and hence contractive, and compression gives ||(Upsilon'_j)_q(T)||<=||Lambda_j||^2*||Phi_q(T)||<=||T||. The norm in M_q(B)=direct-sum_j M_q(B(L_j)) is max_j of the component norms; therefore ||Upsilon'_q(T)||<=||T|| for every q, and taking suprema gives ||Upsilon'||_cb<=1 without any factor depending on q or m.
